route: Work permit (Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs)

permit.applies: The employer, on the foreign employee's behalf (with a power of attorney), to the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs.
permit.first: The Ministry of Labour's approval before travel; a certificate of expertise approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; the employer within the 50% foreign-staff limit.
permit.eligibility: the Foreign Workers Section within the Directorate of Labor and Vocational Training is tasked with issuing work permits to skilled foreign workers

sources.title: Channel 8, Iraq's Labor Ministry Outlines New Work Permit Mechanism for Foreign Workers (March 2025)
sources.said: the Foreign Workers Section within the Directorate of Labor and Vocational Training is tasked with issuing work permits to skilled foreign workers. He emphasized that applicants must present a certified certificate of expertise approved by the Iraqi Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Employers must also adhere to a 50% employment quota, hiring an equal number of Iraqi and foreign workers.

sources.title: Al Tamimi & Co., Work Permits and Foreign Employment in Iraq
sources.said: Employers in Iraq may apply for work permits on behalf of their foreign employees. … In order to obtain a work permit, initially, the approval of the Ministry of Labour is required. … The validity of the work permit is limited to one year, according to the valid regulations, to be renewed every year upon a request from the employer, at least one month prior to the expiry date of the work permit.

note: Federal Iraq: the Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs' Foreign Workers Section issues work permits to skilled foreign workers on a certificate of expertise approved by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, with employers hiring Iraqis and foreigners in equal number (the Ministry's spokesman to INA, March 2025, via Channel 8). Al Tamimi & Co. (a law firm) reads the instructions as requiring the Ministry's approval before travel and the follow-up within seven days of entry, a permit of one year renewed yearly on the employer's request a month before expiry. The Ministry of Justice's copy of the recruitment instructions reset the connection, so the instructions themselves were not read; no fee schedule was found. The Kurdistan Region's own regulation is not modelled apart.
